# Gender Expression Style

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GenderExpressionStyle>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A style of gender expression — a VALUE pointed at by [`gmeow:expressionValue`](../properties/gmeow-expressionValue.md), never a subclass. Open: a style not seeded here is a fresh individual with [rdfs:label.](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the presentation style a [`gmeow:expressionValue`](../properties/gmeow-expressionValue.md) points at; mint a fresh individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) when no seeded style fits.

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling a style as a subclass or a forced enum, and avoid treating any seeded style as a default; the values are co-equal ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md) individual or add a fresh one with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label); expose it only through a [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](gmeow-GenderExpression.md) facet.

### Examples

- ex:expressionButch a [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "butch"@en.
